name: trip-master-plan
description: Plan a trip end-to-end and deliver a versioned HTML MASTER itinerary: assessment interview, date-verified attractions and local events, route alternatives, real-geodata SVG maps whose routes follow actual roads, day cards with drive times, Wikimedia photos with credits, a weather widget, and copy-to-clipboard research prompts. Ships the trip-fact-checker agent for the adversarial audit phase.
